description: This Java class 'BinaryValidationResult' encapsulates the outcome of a binary validation process, indicating whether validation succeeded or failed, and if failed, providing a reason via an exception.

classes.name: BinaryValidationResult
classes.description: A final, thread-unsafe class representing the result of a validation process with a binary outcome (valid or invalid). It contains static factory methods to create valid or invalid instances, and provides methods to check validity and retrieve the reason for invalidity.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Creates and returns a valid BinaryValidationResult instance (no reason for invalidity).

methods.name: invalid
methods.description: Creates and returns an invalid BinaryValidationResult instance with the given Throwable as the reason for invalidity.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the validation result is valid (i.e., no reason for invalidity).

methods.name: getReasonForInvalidity
methods.description: Returns the Throwable reason for invalidity if present, otherwise null.
